quote: Yes. My wife. The wife. Okay. Perfect.
stewart_read: The wife is confirmed as co-owner on title, which per protocol means she should be included in the eventual specialist appointment. The rep acknowledges her existence but never revisits this when scheduling the callback for 'tomorrow at 11AM' with Jeff alone.
alternative_hypothesis: The rep may be deferring spouse-inclusion to the specialist's callback rather than handling it himself, since this call is only securing a callback slot, not the full design review.
coaching_implication: Coach the rep to ask directly whether the wife should be on the callback, e.g. 'Should we plan for your wife to join that call too since she's on the title?' — this is a cheap add that protects the appointment structurally.

quote: you guys represent you guys represent the Tesla ones as well?

coaching_implication: This is a minor, low-urgency case per schema guidance (expectation gap is rare and narrow) — no correction was needed here since Jeff didn't push further, but the rep should be aware the closer may need to clarify Ion sells its own black-panel-capable product, not Tesla panels.

quote: and we're painting the house black. I was like, you know what? I could kill a couple birds with, you know, a few stones. What would it cost to put in black solar paneling?

coaching_implication: Rep validated this warmly in the moment but never tied it back into the close or button-up (e.g., referencing it in the appointment recap or promised text). Coach the rep to use distinctive customer-stated motivators as tieback material for the follow-up text per text_after_call.required_elements.

stewart_read: Customer states $300/month and volunteers 'too much' unprompted — an emotionally loaded bill figure. Rep acknowledges ('Oh, jeez. Yeah. That's a lot to be paying for electricity.') but does not flip it into a forward-pulling reason to act.
alternative_hypothesis: The rep may be intentionally leaving the emotional flip to the specialist since this call's job is narrowly to collect usage data and schedule the callback.
coaching_implication: Coach the ask-acknowledge-flip pattern: after acknowledging the pain, tie it forward, e.g., referencing that the specialist call will show exactly how much of that $300 could be replaced — this is a cheap, high-leverage addition that costs seconds.

quote: just to actually go over this information with you, show you what the design will look like. And so we can give you a callback as early as tomorrow for what day would work better for you, Jeff?

coaching_implication: Datetime lock-in itself was well executed; the gap is upstream (not inviting the wife), not in this exchange's mechanics — coach the rep to layer the spouse-inclusion question into this same booking beat.
